item.title: Ever wonder how the Fed's interest rate actually works? We've got answers
item.description: The Federal Reserve just raised interest rates this week for the first time this year. So how does it actually work? And what does it mean for the economy — and the rest of us? Here are some answers.

item.title: How a pizza app changed our relationship with waiting
item.description: Status trackers are ubiquitous on online apps and ordering. We have the story the seminal Domino's Pizza Tracker that led to many copies, and we check on why many of the trackers now aren't accurate.

item.title: Warren Buffett steps down as Berkshire Hathaway chairman
item.description: Warren Buffett is stepping down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway after serving in the role for more than 50 years. His son, Howard, will become Berkshire Hathaway's new chairman

item.title: Could trees developed with gene-editing technology protect Florida's citrus industry?
item.description: A bacterial infection is wiping out Florida's citrus trees. Growers hope a rootstock developed with gene-editing technology could keep the disease at bay.

item.title: A bad year for the crypto industry just got a lot worse
item.description: The cryptocurrency industry just suffered a major defeat in a bill they had badly wanted to get through the Senate. It's the latest setback in a terrible year for the sector.

item.title: How Jared Kushner is mixing U.S. diplomacy with his billion-dollar business
item.description: The New Yorker's Dexter Filkins says while Trump's son-in-law is a U.S. special envoy negotiating peace, he's also working on private business deals, raising billions in some of the same countries.
